name: Himawari Uzumaki
source:
Himawari Uzumaki is a citizen of Konohagakure. Himawari has light blue eyes and dark blue hair. Himawari is the second and youngest child of [url=https://vndb.org/c105088]Naruto[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c105094]Hinata Uzumaki[/url], born two years after her brother, [url=https://vndb.org/c105092]Boruto[/url]. Himawari is a cheerful and considerate girl. At the same time, Himawari has a temper; she can become very violent when provoked. When her favourite plush was accidentally damaged by Boruto, she assaulted him. At a very young age, due to her Hyūga heritage, Himawari subconsciously awakened the Byakugan in anger after her favourite toy was torn by Boruto.

[In game description]
